parties.petitioner: M/S JSW Ispat Special Products Limited

summary: Contempt petition filed for willful disobedience of Supreme Court's judgment in Ghanshyam Mishra case; demand notices issued post-approval of resolution plan under IBC, 2016; dues for period prior to resolution not part of plan; claims barred under Section 31(1) IBC; authorities bound despite non-participation; notices violate binding effect of resolution plan; good faith defense rejected; contempt established.
final_judgment: Contempt petition allowed; demand notices quashed; proceedings based on pre-resolution dues barred; respondents directed to refrain from initiating recovery actions contrary to IBC and prior SC judgment.
